llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed local course-generation workflow that reads user-selected materials, writes course outputs, and runs a local verifier without network or credential use.

dimensions.detail: Filesystem access is necessary for the purpose and is disclosed, though users should scope input directories carefully because transcripts and course materials may contain private client information.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package includes local shell and Python verifier scripts and requires Python 3.10+, but it does not install dependencies, request credentials, or configure external services.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions limit reads to user-specified material ranges, make generated output locations explicit, keep source material read-only by default, and require user direction before overwrite, move, archive, or extraction workflows.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background workers, autostart, privilege escalation, credential access, or unbounded persistence were found; optional config files and archives are user-directed, and self-tests write only temporary fixtures.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, generated outputs, optional archive/extract modes, manifest tracking, and verifier scripts fit together as a course-generation and validation workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the skill read the transcript or course folders you choose and write course files locally. Review destination paths before archive or move operations, especially when materials include client or confidential information.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The skill does use file read/write and local script execution, but SKILL.md explicitly discloses those behaviors, scopes them to user-selected inputs and outputs, and states the verifier does not modify course files or use the network.
[TP4] expected: Validation, hashing, and consistency checks are not hidden auxiliary behavior; they are described throughout the workflow as the acceptance gate for generated course artifacts and are coherent with the purpose.
